question: Should OpenClaw adopt purpose-specific memory role slots through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504, narrow this to specific coexistence fixes, or keep the current single memory slot model?
rationale: The request adds public plugin/config API surface and changes memory/session routing semantics, while VISION.md currently documents both plugin extensibility and a one-active-memory-slot direction.

options.title: Review the linked role-slot PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and make the product/API decision in the existing implementation PR, including the role taxonomy, per-agent inheritance, and legacy migration window.

options.title: Narrow to coexistence fixes
options.body: Reject the broad role taxonomy for now and track only specific gaps such as dreaming coexistence, diagnostics wording, or selected plugin runtime loading.

options.title: Retain single-slot memory
options.body: Close the direction after a maintainer explicitly decides that memory composition should stay outside core or use existing plugin-side patterns.

recommendation.title: Review the linked role-slot PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and make the product/API decision in the existing implementation PR, including the role taxonomy, per-agent inheritance, and legacy migration window.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-line ownership and plugin public-surface work make this the strongest available product/API routing candidate from the inspected history.
